title: feat(ui): record-mode currency — each record shows its own currency; ISO 4217 code select pre-filled with the organization currency; no cross-currency totals; Studio currency section
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5 _Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9oTskgBVZmtxXLAEh251Cb)_ Fixes #27188 Merge-after: #27268 ⛔ not released alone — R1: pairs with #27184, #27186, #27187, #27188 (one Version Packages release) Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added Declaration note: while this PR is stacked on #27268 its diff against `main` carries #27268's protocol change (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`), so these two lines are #27268's own (`.changeset/27184-currency-record-mode.md`). This card's own changesets declare `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么：** record 模式的金额按每条记录自己的币种显示（列表、表单、详情、仪表盘、甘特提示）；币种码字段变成 ISO 4217 分组搜索下拉，「可用」组含组织币种和该对象已用过的币种，新建时预填组织币种；列表筛选里 record 金额条件带必填币种选择，生成「金额条件 且 币种 = C」；列表页脚与非按币种分组的合计不再跨币种相加；Studio 字段编辑器新增币种模式、币种字段选择和「创建币种字段」；分享链接页的 record 金额也按记录自己的币种显示。 - **为什么改：** 没有这一步，record 字段会显示租户币种符号，比今天更错（ADR-0144 D9：R1 必含）。 - **风险与回滚：** 只影响声明 `currencyMode: 'record'` 的字段和声明 ISO 4217 值域的文本字段；dynamic / fixed 字段行为不变（原有测试全过）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - **先看：** `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts`（解析器，record 分支）、`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filterRecordCurrency.ts`（筛选配对）、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/usedCurrencyCodes.ts`（已用币种查询）、`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/recordCurrencyAggregates.ts`（合计规则）。 - **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx`，应见三行 $ / € / ¥，无币种的行显示纯数字。 - **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地（合并顺序在 #27268 之后）。 ## What changes ADR-0144 D2 (the record currency lives in a sibling code field), D6 (raw aggregates over a record-mode amount stand only inside one currency) and D8 rule 4 (the form pre-fills the organization currency; the stored value is always explicit), on the renderer side. - **Resolver** (`@object-ui/i18n`). `resolveFieldCurrency(field, tenantDefault, record?)` gains an optional record. Under `currencyMode: 'record'` it reads only `record[currencyConfig.currencyField]`; no record or a blank code resolves to `undefined`, so the face shows a plain number. It never falls back to the tenant default, a node-level `currency` or a stray `defaultCurrency`. `dynamic` / `fixed` are unchanged. New `recordCurrencyField(field)` names the pointer; `FieldCurrencyConfig` types the three modes. - **Faces that hold the record now pass it.** `CurrencyCellRenderer` and the formula cell (the grid already hands `dependentValues={row}`), `CurrencyField` (symbol, minor-unit decimals and spinner step follow the selected code), the form renderer (hands the live record to the `currency` and `formula` widgets, `RECORD_CURRENCY_WIDGET_TYPES`), the grid's mobile card, the record page's summary chips, the dashboard table cell and record drawer (`FieldMeta.currencyConfig`, copied only for record mode), and Gantt tooltips. - **Code field.** A `text` field declaring `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'` renders `CurrencyCodeField`: a searchable select grouped "Available" (home currency, then rated, then the codes in use) and "All currencies (ISO 4217)", offering only codes `isValueDomainMember('iso_4217_currency', code)` accepts. Re-selecting the selected code keeps it (no click-to-clear). The picker is `CurrencyCodePicker` in `@object-ui/components`, shared with the filter row below. - **Used codes** (`@object-ui/components` form renderer, `usedCurrencyCodes.ts`). For every ISO 4217 code field on a form with an `objectName`, the renderer asks `dataSource.queryGroupHeaders(object, compileListViewGroupQuery(grouped by the code field))` once, keyed on content, and hands the distinct stored codes down on the field's own metadata as `usedCurrencyCodes`. No widget-contract key. All six plugin-form hosts already put `objectName` on the form schema, so this one seam covers them. A data source without `queryGroupHeaders` is not asked (`aggregate` may degrade to a full fetch); a failed read hands nothing down. Either way the picker offers home + rated + the record's own code. - **Filters** (`@object-ui/components` FilterBuilder, `@object-ui/plugin-list`). A builder field entry may carry `currencyField` (the list sets it from `currencyConfig` for record-mode amounts). A value-comparing row on such an amount draws a required currency picker, defaulting to `localization.currency`. The builder emits the code condition as a companion row of the same flat group, `{ id: '::currency', field: , operator: 'equals', value: C }`, so the group lowers to `amount op X AND code = C` everywhere it is lowered (`convertFilterGroupToAST` gives `['and', ['amount','>',100], ['currency_code','=','USD']]`) and stored filters keep the `ViewFilterRule` shape. The companion is drawn as the picker, never as a row, and goes when its amount row goes, switches to a non-pairing field, or switches to a presence operator. A paired group cannot be toggled to OR, because under OR the pair would split; a stored OR group shows why. Opening a stored filter emits nothing (a stored amount row without a code shows a blank, invalid picker until the next edit). The toolbar's filter count does not count companions. - **Create forms** (`@object-ui/plugin-form`). `SeedContext.homeCurrency`: a code field that some record-mode amount points at, with no declared default, opens on `localization.currency`. Wired into ObjectForm, DrawerForm, ModalForm, SplitForm, TabbedForm and WizardForm. Edit forms are not seeded, so opening a record never rewrites its stored code. - **Totals** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). The footer draws no sum / avg / min / max for a record-mode amount; counts stand. Group-header aggregations keep those only when the grid is grouped by the amount's code field (`honestGroupAggregations`, applied before both the server header query and client bucketing). The home field is a `dynamic` amount and totals as before. - **Studio** (`@object-ui/app-shell`). A currency field, or a formula returning `currency`, gets a currency section (`CurrencyConfigField`): mode, the fixed code, and under `record` a `currencyField` picker listing only the object's `text` + ISO 4217 fields, with "Create currency field", which appends `currency_code` (`type: 'text'`, `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'`, `required: true`) and sets the pointer in one write. A mode switch keeps only the keys that mode reads. - **Share links** (`@objectstack/types`, `@object-ui/console`; R1 rider from #27268's contract review). The resolve answer's field projection (`buildShareLinkResolveAnswer`) carried only `currencyMode` and `defaultCurrency`, so a shared record-mode amount rendered as a plain number. A currency field's projected `currencyConfig` now also carries `currencyField`, only when the answer's `record` carries that code field, so a link that redacts the code field discloses neither the code nor the field's name and the amount shows as a plain number. The shared-record page passes the shared record to the currency face as `dependentValues`, so the amount shows in its own record's currency. - **i18n.** `fields.currencyCode.*` in all eleven locale packs; `designer.field.currency.*` in the studio namespace (en, zh). File surface beyond the Claim's list, accepted by the epic PM: `ui/packages/plugin-grid`, `ui/packages/components`; also `ui/packages/plugin-form`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt` (one resolver call each, plus the form seeding), and `ui/packages/plugin-list` (the list filter's `currencyField` and filter count). ## Tests - `i18n/src/__tests__/resolveFieldCurrency.recordMode-27188.test.ts` — the record-mode truth table. - `fields/src/__tests__/recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx` — cells in USD / EUR / JPY, no-code rows plain, the amount box's symbol and step (USD 0.01, JPY 1, KWD 0.001), the code select's groups and domain filter, `TextField` routing. - `plugin-form/src/__tests__/recordCurrencySeed-27188.test.ts` — seeding, unset setting, author default and caller record win. - `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/recordCurrencyAggregates-27188.test.tsx` — footer refuses money aggregates over record mode, counts stand, home field sums; group aggregations by grouping field. - `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/recordFields.recordCurrency-27188.test.tsx` — dashboard cells per row. - `app-shell/.../CurrencyConfigField.recordMode-27188.test.tsx` — mode switch, candidates, and the create shortcut's output parses under `ObjectSchema`. - `components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-used-currency-codes-27188.test.tsx` — the query shape, the distinct domain-valid read, one ask per object across re-renders, no ask without an object or the capability, a failed read. - `components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-record-currency-27188.test.tsx` — the pairing rules, one picker per paired row, a new row on the home currency, removal, the stored blank picker emitting nothing, the AND lock and the OR notice. - `plugin-list/src/__tests__/convertFilterGroupToAST.recordCurrency-27188.test.ts` — the pair lowers to `amount op X AND code = C`. - `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` gains: the pointer is projected when the record carries the code field, and a redacted code field is never named. - `console/src/pages/SharedRecordPage.recordCurrency-27188.test.tsx` — a shared record-mode amount shows its record's currency (EUR, then JPY), and a hidden code field leaves a plain number. - `fields/.../recordCurrency.faces-27188.test.tsx` gains: the used codes off `field.usedCurrencyCodes` appear in "Available" after the home currency. ## Acceptance notes - **Seat ruling: A/A** (epic PM, on the two open questions of the first report). (1) The form reads the used codes once per object and passes them on the field metadata, with no widget-contract key. (2) The filter row gets a required currency picker defaulting to the organization currency, and the builder emits `amount op X AND code = C`. Both are built here. - **Rated group is a seam.** `ratedCurrencyCodes()` in `CurrencyCodeField.tsx` returns nothing until `sys_exchange_rate` ships (R2, #27185). - **Used codes, where asked.** The read rides the form renderer, the seam every form host already reaches with `objectName`, rather than six host-level copies. It is a per-mount read: a code first used after the form opened shows up on the next open. - **Filter scope.** The pairing is the list's filter builder (`FilterBuilder` + `ListView`). The sharing-rule criteria editor (`FilterConditionField`, stored as a Mongo-style object) is not paired: it re-ids rows on every read, so a code condition there stays a row the author writes. - **No organization currency.** With `localization.currency` unset a new pair's code is blank and the picker is marked invalid; the list's lowering drops a blank row, so that filter compares the amount alone until a code is picked. - **Minor units.** The amount box reads the existing `currencyDisplayWidth` / `currencyFractionDigits` reader (CLDR via `Intl`), which `CURRENCY_FRACTION_DIGITS` mirrors by construction (its header); no second table. - **Home field display** (`homeAmount`) is #27196's. - **Metric tiles** already show a plain number for a record-mode aggregate (the resolver has no record); the build-time refusal is #27187's. ## Verification Head `e128ccc8` (a Studio test for #27268's `defaultCurrency` refusal) on `26913b3c`, a second merge commit bringing in #27268 at `b6f152bd` (no conflicts), on `c36aa49e` (ledgers this card's two new reads in the form-field channel census) on `66a421cc` (restores the `removeCondition` line objectui#8415's source pin reads) on `8bcaa1bc` (the share-link rider) on `ad386034`, a merge commit bringing in #27268 at its final head `90114641` (no rebase), on top of this card's commits `cc403075` and `7520d3e4`. Two conflicts: - `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts`. #27268 made record mode resolve to `undefined` with no tenant fallback. This branch reads the record's code when the caller passes the row. The record read is kept, and a call with no record still resolves to `undefined`, which #27268's own `resolveFieldCurrency.test.ts` cases pin. #27268's doc text is kept, with the record paragraph reworded for the row read. - `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`: both new import blocks kept. No generated file conflicted; `check:generated` (spec) passes at this head. ADR-0144 citations (D2, D3, D6, D8 rules 3 and 4, D9) were re-read against the landed `docs/adr/0144-…md` and hold.
Targeted tests — 49 files, 786 tests, exit 0 ``` cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 (every *27188* test above, #27268's resolveFieldCurrency suites, every components filter-builder suite, form-data-source-wiring, form-dependent-values, the plugin-list convertFilterGroupToAST suites, filter-operator-ast-parity and filter-count suites, and the currency neighbours: currencyMode.faces-10422, CurrencyField.minorUnits, TextField.maxLength-10179, optionDefaultSeed-11914, useColumnSummary.currencyMode-10422, recordFields.currencyConfig-10463, ObjectFieldInspector.valueDomain-7597) Test Files 49 passed (49) Tests 786 passed (786) os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 ``` Before the merge, the neighbouring-package run (i18n, components form renderer and custom, fields widgets, plugin-list filter suites) was 328 files, 3544 passed, 30 skipped.
Type-check and lint `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG type-check` exit 0 at `ad386034` for i18n, fields, components, plugin-form, plugin-grid, plugin-list, plugin-dashboard, plugin-detail, plugin-gantt, app-shell, after building their dependency closure. `pnpm exec eslint` over every ui file this card touches: 0 errors.
Ablations at ad386034 — three, each red then restored - Resolver record branch, `ui/packages/i18n/src/currency.ts`: `currencyMode === 'record'` → `'ABLATED'` (blob `82ae7ac6` → `c78a363b`): 7 failed / 8 passed across the i18n record-mode suite and the fields faces suite. - Used codes hand-off, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`: `withUsedCurrencyCodes(field.field || field, …)` → `field.field || field` (blob `12d5c6b5` → `18cbb6d6`): 1 failed / 6 passed. - Filter pairing, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filterRecordCurrency.ts`: `pairedCurrencyField` answers `undefined` (blob `025b1560` → `d78defb9`): 9 failed / 4 passed across the builder suite and the AST lowering. Each restored by `ablation-replace.mjs`: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
Share-link rider at 8bcaa1bc - Tests: `@objectstack/runtime` `share-links-field-projection.test.ts` 12 passed; `@objectstack/types` `share-link-resolve-answer.test.ts` 9 passed; console `SharedRecordPage.recordCurrency-27188`, `SharedRecordPage-27121`, `shared-record-shape` 22 passed. All exit 0 under `os-verify-lock`. - Type-check: `@objectstack/types` and `@object-ui/console` exit 0. eslint over the five files: 0 errors. - Ablation, console page: `dependentValues={record}` → `dependentValues={undefined}` in `SharedRecordFields.tsx` (blob `e4ce54ff` → `88b99e73`): 2 failed / 1 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD. - Ablation, projection: the `currencyField` spread → `false ? … : {}` in `share-link-resolve-answer.ts` (blob `8c7a3bd5` → `57379712`): 1 failed / 8 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD.
CI fixes at 66a421cc and c36aa49e CI's Test UI at `8bcaa1bc` failed one test: `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-condition-id-8415.test.ts` reads `removeCondition`'s id filter verbatim, and this card had widened it to also drop the companion. The line is back to the pinned form. The companion still goes with its amount row, because `handleChange` runs `syncRecordCurrencyRows`, which drops a companion whose amount row is gone. The "removing the amount row removes its code condition" case covers this. - Tests: the #8415 pin plus every components `__tests__` and `custom/__tests__` suite, 255 files, 2431 passed, 7 skipped, exit 0 under `os-verify-lock`. - Type-check: `@object-ui/components` exit 0. eslint: 0 errors. CI's Test UI at `8bcaa1bc` also failed `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx`, which measures every key the form-field channel reads by name. This card adds two reads: the form's used-codes hand-off (`usedCurrencyCodes.ts`) reads the entry's `field` stash and `valueDomain`, and the currency-code widget reads `valueDomain` off its carrier. `usedCurrencyCodes.ts` joins the `field` row's readers. `valueDomain` gets a RUNTIME-ONLY ledger row: it is object-field metadata (ADR-0144 D2) the code field takes from the object, so it is ledgered rather than declared on `FormFieldSchema`. - Tests: the census and its effects file, 2 files, 120 passed, exit 0 under `os-verify-lock`.
Second bring-in of #27268 at b6f152bd #27268 now refuses `defaultCurrency` under `currencyMode: 'record'`, and `currencyField` has `.min(1)`. The merge had no conflicts. `check:generated` (spec) passes after a spec rebuild, and no generated file needed a hand edit. The Studio currency section never writes either refused shape. `switchCurrencyMode` drops `defaultCurrency` on the switch to `record`, the pointer picker deletes the key rather than writing `''`, and "Create currency field" writes a fresh `{ currencyMode: 'record', currencyField }`. A new test drives the whole path through the inspector: a fixed EUR amount, a switch to Record, then a picked pointer. It asserts the saved config and parses the saved object with `ObjectSchema`. - Ablation: `switchCurrencyMode` carries `prev.defaultCurrency` into `record` (blob `ad4d29d0` → `8cd4f3de`): 2 failed / 3 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD. - Tests: the targeted ui set plus the Studio, census and #8415 files, 51 files, 831 passed. Spec `currency-config-record-mode.test.ts`: 15 passed. Share-link runtime, types and console: 12, 9 and 22 passed. All exit 0 under `os-verify-lock`. - Type-check: i18n, fields, components, plugin-list, app-shell and console exit 0. - Gates: the 27 local re-runs, plus the 8 families `dispatch-gates --commands` newly derives at this head (`check:adr-anchors`, `bash32-floor`, `cli-command-ids`, `entry-guard`, `parse-guard`, `pnpm-filter-targets`, `pnpm-flag-spellings`, `scripts-symbol-anchors`), exit 0 each.
Derived gates — 27 local runs, exit 0 each `dispatch-gates --commands` at `ad386034` and again at `8bcaa1bc` derives the same 116 families, most matched by #27268's paths (`packages/spec`, `skills/`, `content/docs`, `platform-objects`), which #27268's own green CI ran. Re-run locally: the 19 families matched by this card's paths, plus `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:role-word`, and `@objectstack/spec check:generated`. The rest are CI's.
